integrity: The lower bound is the published integer-mean corollary of arXiv:2208.12702. The new sharpness construction is proved analytically using truncated geometric laws, strict monotonicity of their mean in the geometric parameter, and two explicit limits. The bundled numerical checker is supplemental. No independent audit has been performed.
scientific_limitations: The result determines the sharp infimum for the integer-mean subclass by an approximating finite-support family. It does not establish attainment of the infimum, an optimal support-size rate, or sharper constants for narrower subclasses such as Bernoulli sums or Poisson laws.
title: Sharp integer-mean lower tail for discrete log-concave laws
